name: comm
description: Example ORDERED-SINK plugin — a stand-in for a comm / PLC / MES forwarder. Marked "sink": true, so the host STAGES a script's xi::use("<this>").process(rec) and flushes it AFTER the inspect, inside the ordered-emit gate. The records arrive here in FRAME (arrival) order even under parallel dispatch (dispatch_threads > 1), instead of completion order. Each delivery carries the host-stamped "$seq" (the frame's arrival id) for correlation / gap detection. A real comm plugin would forward each record to the line here; this demo records the $seq it received, in order, and exposes it via exchange("get_received").

inputs.name: any
inputs.doc: { key -> data, $seq } — host stamps $seq (frame arrival id)

exchange.doc: -> {received:[seq,...], count} — the $seq values seen, in delivery order
